title: Fix Unhandled Promise Rejection Stall in AsyncQueue
description: The AsyncQueue concurrency limiter stalls when a pushed worker task rejects. Worker slots are never decremented on error, starving subsequent queued tasks indefinitely. Your goal is to ensure failed tasks decrement the active concurrency count, trigger subsequent queued items, and propagate the rejection to the caller without hanging the worker loop.

publicTests.name: Sequential successful tasks resolve in order
Respects maximum concurrency limit of 2

hiddenTests.name: Releasing worker slot upon task error and continuing subsequent tasks
Rapid burst rejection drain with concurrency 2
Immediate synchronous throw within task function

title: Prevent Object Mutation & Prototype Contamination in deepMerge
description: The deepMerge utility inadvertently mutates nested source objects and fails when merging objects with null prototypes or undefined properties. You must refactor deepMerge to produce pure immutable clones of nested objects while safely ignoring prototype properties and handling arrays cleanly.

publicTests.name: Merges non-overlapping properties
Merges nested sub-objects

hiddenTests.name: Preserves original nested source objects from mutation
Handles null and primitive values in nested positions without throwing
Safeguards against __proto__ prototype pollution

title: Fix Fractional Refill Drift in TokenBucket Limiter
description: The TokenBucket rate limiter loses fractional tokens between rapid refill checks because integer flooring drops sub-millisecond accruals. This causes high-throughput API clients to starve and be falsely rate-limited. Fix the time-delta accrual and ensure tokens cap at max capacity.

publicTests.name: Consumes available tokens within initial capacity

hiddenTests.name: Smooth fractional refill over short intervals (200ms)
Does not overflow beyond maximum capacity over long periods
